source_h5.subset_note: 10M-flow BUDGET SUBSET; month coverage measured from TIME_FIRST

split.flow_unit: one H5 table row is one flow; no packet-level split was used

radius_convention: Columns WITHOUT a `_ref_radius` suffix (everything inside `per_rung`) use the WRONG inlined radius `(sqrt(m) + 2.9604)/sqrt(n)`, which omits BOTH 0.5 factors and is exactly 2x the reference implementation src/eibo/statcore.py::tv_upper_bound. Those values are UNDERSTATED and MUST NOT be cited; at M=1 they read 292/990 (upper_side_fraction) and 289/990 (gate_fraction_both). Columns WITH a `_ref_radius` suffix use the reference radius `0.5*sqrt(m/n) + 0.5*2.9604/sqrt(n)` and are the ones to cite: at M=1 the upper side is 340/990 and the gate is 336/990.
per_rung_note: READ THIS BEFORE QUOTING ANY M=1 NUMBER FROM THIS FILE. Two different quantities circulate and have ALREADY been confused once in this project: (a) 289/990 is the `per_rung` M=1 value (`gate_fraction_both`), computed with a PROXY lower-side criterion (`tv_hat > T(n)`, the band's lower EDGE) AND an understated 2x radius -- it is NOT the gate under any correct convention; (b) 336/990 is the GATE under the canonical full-n convention (lower side `eps_lo > 0.05` measured for all 990 pairs, upper side on the reference radius). A third figure, 292/990, is the same understated-radius upper side as (a) but without the proxy. Do NOT treat 289 as 'the old-convention gate' -- no artifact ever contained such a value.
joint_gate_cross_reference_source: q1_lower_side_full_n.json -- the full-n run that measured the lower side for ALL 990 pairs with the 20,000-flow cap removed. This is the authoritative gate.
full_n_measurement_status: FULLY MEASURED. The lower side was recomputed at full n for all 990 pairs with the cap removed (measured_full_n_pair_count = 990, assumed_pair_count = 0), and the upper condition was recomputed row-by-row through the repository function (340 pass, 0 internal mismatches). The gate is 336. An earlier [333, 336] range is SUPERSEDED -- it belonged to a half-measured state in which 282 pairs' lower side was assumed; no part of the gate is assumed now.
gate_convention_sensitivity: The gate is 336 under the canonical (full-n) convention; it would be 335 under the capped convention; the entire difference is pair (21,23) crossing 0.05. All five boundary pairs lie in the upper set. The nearest in-gate margin is +0.008781 and the nearest upper-only margin is -0.007275, with within_0.005_count = 0 -- so UNDER THE CANONICAL CONVENTION no sample sits close to the line; the convention-dependence of the gate value is the separate matter described in the first clause.

tree_sync_sha256_round2.note: This supersedes tree_sync_sha256, which recorded an earlier sync and is now stale because the files changed twice afterwards. Both keys are kept: the earlier one as history, this one as current. Local is authoritative; direction LOCAL -> SERVER.
tree_sync_sha256_round2.self_reference_caveat: A JSON file cannot contain its own final SHA-256 without changing it, so local_after/remote_after cannot be embedded here. The definitive byte-identity proof is the pair of sha256sum outputs printed in the run report, not any value inside the file.
